PC: Gets pt out of wet clothes
Initiates some form of invasive rewarming
Obtains info from available sources (patient, medics, family, police).
Performs/directs primary survey in orderly fashion.
Directs airway management, recognizing need for and executing RSI.
Initiates another IV and resuscitation fluids via “Level 1”
Performs/directs secondary survey in orderly fashion.
SBP: Participant must use rapid infuser due to lack of availability of warmed IV fluids.
ICS: Organizes team/assigns duties to specific members of the team.
Provides clear instructions to team throughout resuscitation.
PROF: Appears confident and calm & asks for help if needed.
